short_statement_zh: IVEBench 样例采用 IVEBench 官方 MF；FlexiAct 样例采用 FlexiAct 官方 MF。两种实现及采样协议分别记录，分数分开报告。

IVEBench.protocol: CoTracker3 offline; grid10; window60; physical24fps effective frames after removing input pad; no foreground mask
IVEBench.meaning_zh: 可见轨迹重采样后，比较归一化位置与速度，权重0.7/0.3，再做Hungarian匹配。可见帧重采样会压缩遮挡期间的物理时间。
IVEBench.input_scope: H3统一画布和有效帧范围；是官方数值实现下的本地成对评测，未声称复现整套官方榜单输入。

FlexiAct.protocol: author get_tracklets grid55; original49@8fps reference; generated0,3,...144; no foreground mask
FlexiAct.meaning_zh: 逐步位移归一化后求方向余弦相似度，对每条编辑轨迹取最相近参考轨迹并求均值；原代码还对相似度矩阵的对角项减1。
FlexiAct.input_scope: 原始49帧8fps参考与H3输出的对应时刻；原作者函数由adapter原样提取，未修改评分公式。

historical_value_scope.verified_current: 当前inventory的所有有值MF行均标明相应官方实现，导入器绑定实际视频哈希、有效帧、轨迹与评分回执。
historical_value_scope.excluded_from_MF_column: 人工事件区间、速度lag/姿态诊断另列；它们没有写成MF。尚无与实际媒体绑定的正式MF保持null。
historical_value_scope.limitation: 本次限定读取未重建每个早期页面的删除历史，不能据此逐项宣称某个旧proxy数值已删除；当前实际MF来源可核。

samples.label: R89
samples.official_edit_prompt: Add a pair of glasses to the man.
samples.actual_prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for this local video edit, providing the original camera framing, shot structure, visible action sequence, pacing and duration.
<Subject 1> is the man seated on the left side of the table in <Video 1>, wearing a light short-sleeved shirt and holding a beer bottle. He is the target for the added glasses; his original identity and complete drinking performance are retained.
<Subject 2> is the man seated on the right, the background people, original beer bottle, table, papers and bar interior in <Video 1>.
Source context: Two men are sitting at a table in a diner, one of them is drinking a beer and the other is listening attentively.

summary:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Add a pair of glasses to the left-side man holding the bottle, preserving his original drinking motion and the other people and bar setting.
Requested edit: Add a pair of glasses to the man.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - apply the requested edit. Add eyeglasses to the left-side man’s face, following his face position and head motion. Preserve his identity, clothing, arm gestures and complete bottle-raising, drinking and lowering sequence with the same timing.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the right-side man, background people, bottle, tabletop objects and original bar, including their movements, lighting and placement.
<Video 1> (cut and pacing structure): fully_preserved - preserve the original camera framing and movement, shot continuity, visible action order, timing and duration.
The requested edit defines the appearance change. The visible subject definitions and unchanged source content govern scene details.

detailed_description:
The target video retains the photographic appearance, lighting and camera composition of <Video 1>.
[Shot 1] The original left-side man now wears eyeglasses while holding his beer bottle at the table. He raises the bottle, drinks and lowers it following <Video 1> in the original sequence and timing. The right-side man and bar background remain as in the source.
The complete visible action sequence and all its phases follow <Video 1> in their original order and timing.

overall_soundscape:
No specific soundscape is requested.

non_diegetic_music:
No specific music is requested.

<Subject 2> is the original man, both people's identities and visible body features, the building entrance, stone facade, ground and remaining surroundings.
Source context: A man and a woman wearing a white outfit are walking outside a building. The woman is holding the man's arm and they are talking to each other.

summary:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Change the woman's white outfit to black while preserving the two people and their original interaction outside the building.
Requested edit: Change the white outfit to black

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - apply the requested clothing-color change. Preserve the woman, garment shape, folds and her original arm contacts, turns, steps and movements around the man.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the man's face and suit, both people's original actions and interaction, the stone building, entrance, ground, lighting and camera movement.
<Video 1> (cut and pacing structure): fully_preserved - preserve the original camera framing and movement, shot continuity, visible action order, timing and duration.
The requested edit defines the appearance change. The visible subject definitions and unchanged source content govern scene details.

detailed_description:
The target video retains the original visual style, lighting and camera composition of <Video 1>.
[Shot 1] The original woman now wears the same outfit in black beside the original suited man. Their visible arm-holding, turns, steps and changing positions follow <Video 1>, with the original building and surroundings retained.
The complete visible action sequence and all its phases follow <Video 1> in their original order and timing.
